messages.subject: [CHNOSZ] New release 0.9-7 on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

CHNOSZ version 0.9-7 is now available on CRAN. The recent updates to the 
package feature some new vignettes, and new functions:

browse.refs() - open reference links in a web browser
anim.carboxylase() - make an animated GIF of an equilibrium activity diagram
EOSregress() - model heat capacities and volumes of aqueous species 
using various equations

All users are encouraged to upgrade to the new package.

This release of the package also marks the inauguration of the 
CHNOSZ-help mailing list. Consider joining the list to participate in 
help requests and bug reports and to receive future announcements about 
new releases.

Have fun!

Jeff
